item.title: Why WordPress Remains the Most Popular CMS
item.description: WordPress remains the industry standard because of its massive plugin ecosystem, community support, and scalability for diverse web projects. Based on 5 community reports. Linked sources: 5. Known Issues High cost of premium managed hosting Security vulnerabilities in outdated plugins Performance issues with bloated themes Community Q&A Why is WordPress so popular for websites? WordPress is popular because it is open-source, highly customizable through thousands of plugins, and has a massive community of developers.
